model: Data Industrial Series 380 impeller Btu system 380CS / 380HS (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Badger Meter / Data Industrial Series 380 impeller Btu systems (380CS cold, 380HS hot) with the RS-485 output set to BACnet.
summary: The Series 380 is an impeller flow sensor tee with two temperature probes and built-in Btu electronics. Its RS-485 port runs Modbus RTU or BACnet MS/TP (slave). The BACnet map has two temperature inputs and ten analog values: flow and energy rate, flow and energy totals, calculation mode, filter coefficients, specific heat, density and serial number.
notes: The manual prints the analog input IDs as AN1/AN2; they are shown here as AI 1-2.
The BACnet map has no read/write column; all objects are shown as read-only. The matching Modbus registers are all marked read-only.
Units follow the units chosen in the commissioning software; custom units are allowed.
Source: 'Series 380 BACnet Object Map', page 10 (12 objects).

source.title: Series 380 Impeller Btu System Installation & Operation Manual

integration.summary: Commission the meter with the Series 380 software over USB: choose BACnet, then set device name, device ID, baud rate and max master. Read energy rate and total, flow rate and total and the two temperatures.
setup: All setup is done with the Badger Meter Series 380 commissioning software over a mini-USB cable.
MS/TP slave at 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 baud; no default device instance is printed.
The manual suggests building the device ID from the network number plus the MS/TP address.
gotchas: RS-485 is not isolated; do not share the meter's power supply with other devices.
Which line AI 1 and AI 2 read depends on where the tee and remote probe are installed (supply or return).
